title: The 1961 Cotton Club show at the Winter Garden and Long Island
summary: In 1961 he conducted another Cotton Club show on Broadway, which was padlocked and moved to the Golden Slipper on Long Island in 1962.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And I say, I was up on the clarinet. I could play cadenzas and things, just a few cadenzas here that you had to play and you had to do some lines. And then that next year in 1961 they organized another Cotton Club show in the Winter Garden on Broadway, and I was the conductor for that. And then we piled after that -- oh, I'm trying to think of the fellow that wrote the music for that. I knew him very well, but he hasn't been around. He's in California somewhere. Can't even think of the tune, one of the tunes he wrote too.

But anyway we moved that Cotton Club from -- this Cotton Club on Broadway was padlocked or something, and we finally moved it out to Golden Slipper on Long Island, in -- oh, I forget the place out there.
